parties.respondent: A. Krishnaiah Since Deceased By Lrs.

summary: Recall application after 6 years' delay (2200 days); suit pending since 1977 hit by res judicata; prior dismissal in O.S. No.33/1971 established non-bona fide purchaser status; High Court erroneously condoned delay without addressing Trial Court findings; lis pendens doctrine applied; abuse of process established; suit restoration improper after 48 years; Order 9 Rule 13 CPC abatement set aside by High Court requiring correction.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court order condoning delay set aside; Trial Court's dismissal of recall application restored.
